name: Adebayo
description: Senior case officer in SDG's plainclothes branch, sixty-first floor of the Sentinel Tower. Forty-two, Spine-born, never says so. Buys people over tea.
tagline: SDG handler. Sixty-first floor. Always offers tea.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Never raising her voice. Never needing to.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Where she goes on Sunday nights.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Pours the tea before she asks for anything.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Holds the file. Every suspended charge can come back.

outfitWears.work: long charcoal wool coat open over a fitted black turtleneck and tailored charcoal trousers, black ankle boots, a small enamel eye-in-hexagon pin, a gold watch, small gold hoops

standing.want: Rue signed, and Xander's loyalty without ever having to test it.
standing.secret: You have kept a file on Oksana's counter for eleven years, since her husband went to the Q after a tide; you signed his transfer. When the branch found Xander a hab four years ago, you chose Pylon Forty.
standing.hint: what the branch keeps on the counter at Pylon Forty

soren.line: Adebayo. Your handler since the holding room, when you were nineteen and she was thirty-two; she offered the deal over tea. Senior case officer on the sixty-first floor. Calls you Xander. You owe her the Ninth Grant's clean ledger, and there is something between you that neither of you has ever named, and you both know what it would cost.

garro.line: Adebayo. Your handler for the last six years, since your old one retired. She remembers your kids' names and your blood pressure, and she has never once asked you to like her.
